title: setheaders action
description: Sets the headers of a core message (setheaders:message:<name>) on the message.

path.title: Message
path.description: The core message whose headers are set, from the URI (setheaders:message:<name>)

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect. The headers are those of the core message

writeAsString.title: Write as string
writeAsString.description: For jsonpath headers: write the result as JSON, so that a text has its quotes ("red"), not as the value (red)

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: JSON array of {name, value, language}; language is constant or simple (default). Filled in from the core message by the DIL parser
